_comment: The captain's gear (docs/archive/PROGRESSION.md P1). slot: weapon, shield, body, helm, horse. A weapon sets damage, reach, windup and recover; armour adds to the captain troop's armour and speed; a shield sets the block chance; a horse names a mount in troops.json. needs = the level of `skill` (Arms unless named) to use it, rank = the career rank to buy it (0 free company, 1 sworn sword, 2 vassal, 3 lord). look = the sprite part (weapon, shield, body or head). Troop kit (docs/pre-demo/KIT.md KT1): every part a soldier wears is a piece here, looked up by slot and look; troop = no armourer sells it to the captain. Slots legs, feet and hands are troop slots: the captain's legs, feet and hands come with his body piece (its armour is the rest of the suit).
_bases: Fighter bases (KIT.md KT2-KT3): a man's numbers before kit and skill, and what each point of Arms, Riding and Bowcraft adds (Fighter.Build). A soldier is 'man' (a caster 'mage'); the captain is a hero: his skills act through his perks and the battle (BattleCaptain), so his base scales only health and horse.
